idea.title: The 15-second listing video formula
idea.angle: Short videos reach far more people than photo posts. The formula: 0-3 seconds hook, 3-12 seconds tour of four or five spaces, 12-15 seconds the ask with one clear action.

slides.heading: NOBODY FINISHES A **SLOW** VIDEO
slides.body: Long walk-throughs lose people before the best room. Yet short videos reach far more people than photo posts. So keep it short.

slides.heading: 0-3 SECONDS: THE **HOOK**
slides.body: Your best shot with bold text on screen. Like: "4-bed with pool, quiet street."

slides.heading: 3-12 SECONDS: THE **TOUR**
slides.body: Four or five of your best spaces, in the order that sells. Slow, smooth moves. Two to three seconds each.

slides.heading: 12-15 SECONDS: THE **ASK**
slides.body: Price, location and one clear action. "DM TOUR to book a viewing."

slides.heading: THE **PREMIUM** DETAILS
bullets: Light: bright and warm. Dark rooms look small.
Captions: big enough to read with the sound off.
Music: calm for luxury, upbeat for apartments.
Nothing fake: no added furniture, rooms or views.

slides.heading: No time to film? Your **photos** are enough.
slides.body: AI can turn the listing photos you already have into a smooth video. No camera crew. No reshoot.

slides.heading: GET THE FULL **FORMULA**
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
Your listing video doesn't need to be long. It needs to be 15 seconds.

0-3 seconds: your best shot with bold text.
3-12 seconds: four or five of your best spaces, two to three seconds each.
12-15 seconds: price, location and one clear action.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
